note: offload-unseen-apply-1113 (docs/208 s10, P2 of docs/handoff/mono-offthread-next-1113.md): apply correctness for env + bcast apply behind autoffunseen (unseen non-household only), BP and IP. Based on offload3-apply-correctness, repinned to the offpickup1114 pair; counters SAVED by queue.ts (jobFixesCfg adds autoff_; the 11-06 report predates that). Bars: A1-A3 0, exc 0, no crash; dry_eq >= 0.99 (env: autoff_env_apply_dry_eq / autoff_env_applied; bcast: autoff_bcast_dry_eq / autoff_bcast_dry; read from the saved counters, not machine-gated); autoff_*_scope_household > 0 (gated on the household jobs); household Sims behave as with the switches off. Report apply share per world = applied / (applied + apply_none + apply_stale + scope_household + scope_seen + scope_unknown) (counters 482/487, 483/488, 484/489, 957-962). Stop rules (docs/handoff P2): any exception or dry_eq < 0.95: fix before timing; apply share < ~20% on both worlds: park, no timing. Order: smoke, BP env/bcast/household, IP env/bcast/household, BP/IP live (9 jobs). Daytime, one game at a time. Install ts3agent.package.offunseen1113 first (see pinReason). Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/offload-unseen-apply-1113.json. Timing only after this passes: offload-unseen-apply-ab-1113.json.

jobs.note: Smoke (4 min BP, Mode R config like the 11-06 queue, all apply switches + autoffunseen + autoffdry). PASS = 0 crashes, autoff_env_ready >= 1, autoff_bcast_ready >= 1, autoff_env_dry >= 1 (answers reach Sim updates; applied needs an unseen high-LOD Sim, docs/208 s11), exc 0, autoff_ counters appear in the report (queue.ts adds the autoff_ prefix to the report whenever an autoff switch is on, jobFixesCfg l.1035; the 11-06 report predates that). A FAIL stops the queue.

jobs.note: docs/208 s8.2 + s10 env apply with autoffunseen, BP, Mode R reference (A1-A3). PASS = 0 crashes, no freeze, A1-A3 0, autoff_env_exc 0, no new ScriptError. Read from the saved autoff_ counters: dry_eq = autoff_env_apply_dry_eq / autoff_env_applied >= 0.99 (I-404-1; not a fixesRequire rule, counters are integers), autoff_env_scope_household > 0 (household Sims update in natural play, gated), apply share = applied / (applied + apply_none + apply_stale + scope_household + scope_seen + scope_unknown) per world. Household Sims untouched: scope_household counts the updates sent to the game's own call.

jobs.note: docs/208 s8.3 + s10 bcast apply with autoffunseen, BP, Mode R. PASS = 0 crashes, no freeze, bcast A1 = A2 = 0, autoff_bcast_exc 0. Read: autoff_bcast_dry_eq / autoff_bcast_dry >= 0.99, dry_order read not gated (I-402-5), apply share = applied / (applied + apply_none + apply_stale + scope_*). The scope_household gate sits on the household job (household Sims near broadcasters on purpose); here scope_household is read, not gated. Watch the bcast seen share: the UfPosUnseen circle may refuse much work (docs/208 s10).
